context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 Promo Code / Coupon Redemption System fully tested. (4) Admin Coupons: List shows all coupons with type icons, value, min order, usage count, expiry (red if expired), active toggle, edit/delete buttons. WELCOME5 shows 'First-order only' badge. Form has type selector (percent/fixed/free_delivery), value input hides for free_delivery, first-order-only switch, active switch. MOCKED: None new - all coupon flows use real DB.
